MAKE YOUR
NEXT SHOT COUNT.

Move into place. Hold a shot button to prepare. Use the direction keys to aim. Your player hits when the ball is in reach.

01Move firstUse WASD or arrow keys. On a phone, use the direction pad.
02Prepare and aimHold a shot button. The target shows your aim. Preparation slows your movement.
03Find the openingUse Shift to dash or cancel preparation. Recover toward the centre after each shot.
J / SPACETopspinHigh bounce. Keep Rook deep.
KSliceLow bounce. Pull Rook wide.
LFlat / SmashFast finish. Smash a high ball.
ULobLift the ball over a net player.
IDrop shotLand short when Rook is deep.

Serve: Press a shot button to toss. Press again near the top for a fast serve. A late swing can cause a fault.

Win: First to 2 games, with a 2-game lead. At 2–2, play a tiebreak to 7, with a 2-point lead.

Gamepad and classic combinations

Left stick: move and aim. A: topspin. B: slice. X: flat. Y: lob. Left shoulder: drop. Right shoulder: dash. Start: pause. J then K: lob. K then J: drop. J + K: flat. Double-tap J or K for extra power.

MADE FOR
THE RALLY.

An original arcade tennis game inspired by the movement, shot choice, and match play of Mario Tennis for Nintendo 64.

Built on Michael Crosato’s my-3D2dge v0.8.1. Original tennis code, player designs, court, animation, and sound. The coastal backdrop was made with image generation.

Research: Nintendo’s original instruction booklet, Super Mario Wiki, and VBroccoli’s GameFAQs guide. This game has no Nintendo characters, music, logos, or game assets.

Keyboard, gamepad, and touch input. Preferences and records stay in this browser.
